identity: A second primary-school Islamic-education worksheet, same publisher and same layout as doc_a17df83313f0 (which scored 100.0): 20 items, one per printed line, on prayer, Surat al-Maun and the angels. Thirteen are sahh/khata true-false, one is yujibuni / la yujibuni, six are three-way multiple choice.
law: MCQ BANK (section I), the exception to LINE MODE named in checklist v3/v4 PASS 0. Median line 7 tokens, but the line is a QUESTION, not a verse: I2 the stem ends where the options begin, I3 every option is its own unit however short, I5 an internal wa inside the stem or inside an option is bare-noun wa and never cuts. 136 real tokens / 66 units = 2.1 tokens per unit.
reasoning: Only two lines needed thought. (1) @53-@59 al-salatu al-abda min rabbihi | tuqarrib | tubaid | tunaffir - the missing word is the VERB, so the stem is the whole frame al-salat al-abd min rabbihi with a gap in the middle, and the three verbs are the siblings. The dangling-function-word cue of I2 does not fire here; what fires is 0h - find where the N parallel siblings START, and here three finite verbs of the same shape in a row are unmistakable. (2) @124-@130 vs @141-@147: khalaqa allah al-malaika min nar sahh khata is a TRUE-FALSE item, so min nar belongs inside the stem, while khalaqa allah al-malaika min | nur | tin | nar is a three-way choice with a dangling min. The same words, two different item types, decided by what follows - sahh/khata versus three parallel nouns. I checked the latest-well-formed test of 0h on the second: min + nur is well formed, min nur + tin is not, so the stem ends at min. Elsewhere the stems are complete statements and the option pair sahh / khata is two units, applied identically on all thirteen true-false items. The internal wa in atif ala al-yatim wa uhibbuh, in al-khayr wa-al-sharr, in al-naf wa-al-darr and in al-tahiyyat wa-al-salawat is bare coordination inside a stem (I5) - no cut. Nothing in this document is prose, so none of the batch-12 coordinator corrections apply.
